Tyler (Japanese: タイラ Taira) is a character in Pokémon Concierge. He manages certain aspects at the Pokémon Resort such as sanitation and catering, as well as providing fitness lessons.

==History==
Tyler is one of the staff at the Pokémon Resort, specializing in sanitation. He also provides fitness lessons, as well as lessons for swimming, wakeboarding, and yoga. According to Tyler, he provides these lessons "just for fun." Tyler also cooks meals for the customers and other staff at the Resort.

Tyler was raised by his uncle Dan when he was young. According to Tyler, Dan is a kind but firm father figure, and would angrily scold him if he caused trouble. Dan would also take Tyler on rides on his boat. In the Japanese dub, Tyler refers to Dan with the affectionate term おじさん oji-san (literally "uncle", though it is also used as a generic term for "old man").

==Character==
Tyler has an easygoing and happy-go-lucky personality. He is physically fit and is a skilled cook. He also respects and looks up to his uncle Dan.

==Pokémon==
Tyler is often accompanied by a trio of the elemental monkeys, although the trio can sometimes be seen on their own. Tyler calls them his "right-hand Pokémon," and while they are known pranksters, they often help Tyler with various jobs at the Pokémon Resort.
